D: Santa's troublemaking older brother has to help out at the North Pole in the busy week before Christmas.
P: Serve the snacks when Fred arrives at the North Pole.
S: Beef frank in a poppy seed bun with mustard, relish, tomato, pickle, peppers

Beef frankfurts in poppy seed buns dragged through the garden: mustard, green relish, onion, tomato, a pickle spear, peppers and celery salt. Simmer 8 beef frankfurts in water for 5 minutes, then grill 2 minutes for colour. Steam or warm 8 hot dog buns and sprinkle the tops with poppy seeds. Put a frankfurt in each bun. Add a line of yellow mustard and a spoon of green relish, then diced white onion, 2 tomato wedges, a dill pickle spear and 2 pickled peppers. Finish with a pinch of celery salt.
Spiced ginger cookies cut into men and piped with icing

Little gingerbread men with white icing, the kind the elves churn out while Fred upsets the whole workshop. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar, then mix in 300g self-raising flour and 2 tsp ginger. Roll, cut out men and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Pipe on icing once cool.
M: Claus family honey mustard glazed ham
Clove studded leg ham glazed with honey and Dijon mustard

A leg ham scored and glazed with honey, mustard and orange until sticky and caramelised, served with roast potatoes and buttery greens. Remove the rind from a 2.5kg half leg ham, score the fat in a diamond pattern and stud with cloves. Simmer 120ml honey, 3 tbsp Dijon mustard, 60g brown sugar and the juice of 1 orange for 3 minutes. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil alongside. Toss 300g green beans and broccolini in butter. Slice the ham thickly to serve.
W: Brown butter milk chocolate chip cookies with sea salt, served with milk

Big chewy brown butter choc chip cookies with crisp edges and a sprinkle of sea salt, served warm with cold milk. Melt 125g butter and cook until golden brown and nutty, then cool 10 minutes. Beat in 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 220g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 150g chopped milk chocolate. Roll into 12 balls and chill 20 minutes. Bake at 180C for 11 minutes until golden at the edges. Sprinkle with sea salt flakes and serve warm with 1L cold milk.
K: Hot chocolate topped with toasted marshmallows and cinnamon

Thick milk chocolate hot chocolate topped with marshmallows toasted under the grill until golden, with a dusting of cinnamon. Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming, then whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tbsp cocoa until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 heatproof mugs. Pile 4 large marshmallows on each and place the mugs on a tray under a hot grill for 1 minute, watching closely, until the marshmallows are puffed and golden. Dust with a pinch of cinnamon and serve.
